rca: BLOCKING BUG (introduced this iteration): MissionLingala.jsx wrapped two top-level <section> elements inside `{!isChild && (...)}` without a React Fragment, causing 'SyntaxError: Unexpected token, expected ,' (267:6) and breaking webpack compilation for the entire frontend. Reproduction: navigate to any auth-gated page → red 'Compiled with problems' overlay appears, masking the entire app. Fix: wrap the two siblings in `<>...</>` (Fragment). Now all 16 checks pass.
